entities.summary: The Bakar mockery, or Bakar raid, was a raid of the Italian Navy in the last year of World War I. Whilst it had little material effect on the war at sea, it was a particularly bold venture which had a welcome effect on Italian morale, which was at a low ebb following the defeat at Caporetto a few months prior.
